author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: বন্ধনীর verb-এর সঠিক রূপ বসাও (Board: right form of verbs, 0.5×14)।

items.q: The girl sang a song while she ___ the flowers. (pick)
items.rule_bn: একই সময়ে দুটি চলমান কাজ: Past Continuous।

items.q: He said that he ___ ill for a week. (be)
items.rule_bn: reported past-এর আগের অবস্থা: Past Perfect: had been।
চিরসত্য শর্তে: If + present, present: melts।

items.q: He is used to ___ up early. (get)
The letter ___ by him yesterday. (write, passive)
items.rule_bn: passive past: was + past participle: was written।

items.q: I would rather die than ___ my country. (betray)
items.rule_bn: 'would rather ... than'-এর পরে base verb: betray।

items.q: Rice and curry ___ my favourite food. (be)
items.rule_bn: একক খাবার হিসেবে ধরা হয়: is।
